title: Patch: The Maestro, MC Tech, Snom Bunny and a random Plague Counter placement never pick a Dormant card, which no effect reaches
notes: R4322000: The Maestro's field exile, MC Tech's and Snom Bunny's steal and a Plague Counter placement drawn at random (a random cast, or under a Mayor) draw only among the permanents an effect reaches, never a Dormant card (engine: plague::reachable_permanents_on_field; query::enemy_permanents now drops a Dormant backrow card), and MC Tech counts no Dormant card toward its 5. MC Tech's script loses its own copy of the walk, falling from 63 code lines to 50, under COMPLICATED_CODE_LINES (60): it leaves the complicated list, so by R2173001 the lists' readers S #111 Shockwave447 (its complicated pool loses MC Tech) and S #109 xxFreshJack (a BUSTED reader, whose pool MC Tech was never in) are claimed. classify stage 2 against main's build also finds unforced games that play differently touching C #43 Plague Nuke, #13 Jlockeed Shredder-10 and TG #29 Easterner, claimed with --plays. No KEPT_SCRIPTS entry: the engine's pools change for every catalog. Replays this change alters are refused as rules_changed (R767000).

player.title: Random picks pass Dormant cards by
changes: MC Tech no longer counts a Dormant card among the enemy's permanents, a Dormant Field Spell included.
MC Tech is no longer a complicated card, so Shockwave447's random complicated cards can't be it.
fixes: The Maestro could exile a Dormant card, a Dormant Starship and its fused pieces included. It now passes Dormant cards by, and a field of only Dormant cards is skipped.
MC Tech's and Snom Bunny's steal could land on a Dormant Field Spell and take nothing. Both now take an awake permanent.
Plague Counters placed at random, by a card cast at random or while Mayor Medinamogger is on the field, could land on a Dormant card. They never do now.
